final_topology.title: Government Secure Network
final_topology.description: Connect main data center to regional and branch offices with secure internet and remote access.
final_topology.topology_summary: The main data center will be connected to regional and branch offices via a dedicated WAN. A secure internet perimeter with email and web filtering will be implemented, along with remote access capabilities.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n27) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating an asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n28) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) that are segmented, indicating data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n3) in the Main Data Center, which is connected to various nodes, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n22) in the Main Data Center, which is connected to the Internet Gateway (n16), indicating trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access Server' (n17) and an 'Identity Server' (n18) in the Remote Access Zone, indicating MFA is likely required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n23) and 'Web Filter' (n13) in the DMZ, indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Filter' (n13) and 'Email Filter' (n14) in the DMZ, indicating network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) and security devices (e.g., Firewalls, NIDS, NIPS), indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tool' (n29) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating network infrastructure is securely managed using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n18) and 'SIEM' (n19) in the Management Zone, indicating centralized AAA is implemented.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n15) and 'Remote Access Server' (n17) in the Remote Access Zone, indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise's AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'NIDS' (n20) and 'NIPS' (n21) in the Main Data Center, indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n3) and multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) with routing and management links, indicating traffic filtering between network segments is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n24) in the Remote Access Zone, indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Flow Log Collector' (n30) that collects logs from various nodes and zones, indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z8) that is separated from the Main Data Center, indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n31) that connects to various nodes and zones, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.
